layer: CPU FK Instance structural serialization quality gate
research_question: Can BIRD dev SQLite foreign key constraints be encoded as deterministic FK Join-Instance identities while preserving ordered composite column pairs, same-instance inverse edges, and distinct mappings between the same table endpoints?
core_hypothesis: A versioned canonical identity over dataset/database identity, source table, target table, and ordered source-to-target column pairs is independent of PRAGMA group IDs and input enumeration order, while remaining sensitive to component order.
scope_limits: Structure serialization only; no natural-language role semantics or query-conditioned selection claim.
No Role F1, Join Path accuracy, SQL EX, or G-reasoner model claim.
BIRD dev is historical development data, not an independent test set.

historical_fk_reference.source: P2a.5 error attribution and FK Gate report, 2026-10-18; comparison only, no threshold retuning

success_criteria: Discover 11 SQLite schemas and reproduce the historical 103 raw / 100 valid / 3 invalid FK counts; a mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE and stops expansion.
Every valid FK has a deterministic nonempty ID; IDs are unique across valid instances and no different mappings are merged.
IDs remain unchanged under database/FK row enumeration permutations and PRAGMA constraint group ID renumbering.
Changing the ordered component sequence of a composite FK changes its ID.
Each valid FK emits exactly two directed edges that share the same FK instance ID, with reversed ordered column pairs.
Composite components remain one FK instance; different column mappings between the same endpoint tables stay distinct.
stop_conditions: Fewer or more than 11 SQLite files are present.
Read-only schema access fails, required schema fields are absent, or a smoke invariant fails.
Historical denominator mismatch; retain output as INCONCLUSIVE and do not tune the protocol.
CPU time exceeds 1,800 seconds, peak RSS exceeds 16 GiB, or CPU threads exceed 8.

runs.reason: The registered host command referenced missing /usr/bin/time; the runner did not start and read no data.

environment.dependencies: Python standard library only; no installation

implementation.contract_test_result: 9 passed; implementation gate only, not a BIRD experiment result
implementation.prelaunch_correction: A targeted test caught top-level-only SQLite discovery before any BIRD data run; runner now recursively discovers dev database files.

outputs.publication_boundary: Public: protocol, runner/tests, aggregate counts and hashes. Private: database names/paths, DDL, per-FK identities, any query/Gold SQL, and raw logs.
